hierarchy.notes: A live public-receipt inspector with claim-by-claim evidence decoding plus a collapsed bundled contract that never presents fixtures as machine, account, or publish evidence.

allowed_side_effects: server-side lookup of a sanitized public profile handle
user-initiated navigation to a public profile

classification.notes: The route may read one published aggregate through the existing public profile adapter. It never scans a machine, reads provider credentials, mutates usage, or uploads data.

ssa_v2.notes: The live snapshot model, interactive workbench, verdict model, views, and responsive styles are route-local; every source file remains below the project file ceiling.

ssi.notes: Pure snapshot and verdict builders normalize public data before the client workbench decodes claims or renders replay stages.

sstf.notes: Five focused proof contracts and the full 662-test release suite cover handle sanitization, public snapshot output, empty states, fixture/live boundaries, the verifier matrix, semantic controls, responsive CSS, and cockpit invariants.

spe.notes: Pure builders are deterministic; the only runtime read is one bounded public-profile lookup and all interactions remain local or navigational.

srs.notes: Each live metric now exposes what it proves, where it was read from, and what it explicitly cannot prove; the bundled fixture contract remains separately labelled and collapsed.

ssra.notes: Guarded production deploy 6a5720faf6e008d04a942b20 with stamp mrlo2lse-lvrzlu3m passed the full release gate, 30-route build, exact/stable interaction proof, and zero-overflow browser checks at 390x844, 1440x1000, and 3840x2160; production was re-locked after verification.

sas.notes: The route has explicit ownership, public seams, forbidden imports, and a narrow allowlist for one public read, clipboard copy, and profile navigation.

sva.notes: No secret, privileged client, provider credential, raw usage record, prompt, or local file reaches the browser; the live path receives only a normalized public snapshot.

srls.notes: The brick delegates published-profile reads to the upstream data adapter; that adapter owns RLS and this brick imports no privileged client.

sev.notes: The brick requires no environment variables.

ssc.notes: Next and React are inherited from the web package; the evidence cockpit is an existing web-library seam.

sai.notes: Lease, intent, source commit, guarded deployment stamp, owned paths, and current verification are recorded.

code_budget.notes: The server route, snapshot builder, client workbench, verdict model, views, and styles remain focused, route-local, and below 600 lines.

verification.notes: 2 focused tests and TypeScript passed before full release verification.

verification.command: pnpm sma:release-gate && pnpm audit --audit-level high && pnpm build && pnpm --dir packages/web build && git diff --check
verification.notes: 15 SMA tests, 600 package tests, strict telemetry with 0 violations, clean typecheck, 0 known vulnerabilities, and both production builds passed.

verification.command: Chrome DevTools responsive geometry, request audit, and mobile Lighthouse against immutable preview 6a56153f73fb2b149f56c298
verification.notes: 390x844 and 3840x2160 had no horizontal overflow or panel overlap; Lighthouse scored accessibility 100, best practices 100, and agentic browsing 100. Preview SEO was 66 solely because Netlify preview responses intentionally send noindex.

verification.command: production deploy 6a561648e30ad41a89ca1a88 plus Chrome DevTools proof at https://vibeusage.c0vibe.app/proof
verification.notes: Stable-domain mobile Lighthouse scored accessibility, best practices, SEO, and agentic browsing at 100; 390x844 and 3840x2160 had no horizontal overflow, no percent-ready labels, and the verdict fit the first 4K viewport. No fetch, XHR, WebSocket, or event-source request occurred.

verification.command: 5 focused proof tests + pnpm sma:release-gate + 30-route build + guarded canonical production deploy + Playwright exact/stable proof
verification.notes: 662 package tests, 15 control-plane tests, strict telemetry, typecheck, and the production build passed. Preview 6a571f58f6e008caec942a4d and guarded production 6a5720faf6e008d04a942b20 expose four selectable claims with their live values, sources, and non-claims. Clipboard and public-profile navigation pass; exact and stable deployments have zero browser errors, failed requests, or overflow at mobile, desktop, and centered 2640px 4K. Production serves stamp mrlo2lse-lvrzlu3m and is locked to the verified deploy.

install_steps: Provide a compatible evidence cockpit builder.
Run the focused contract and release gate.
known_traps: Never present bundled fixture percentages as product readiness or user evidence.
Never imply that opening this route scans a browser, machine, or provider account.
Publishing remains an explicit CLI action after local dry-run review.

verification.notes: Focused proof boundary contract and TypeScript passed.

created_by.summary: Declared the Proof Center and its fixture-versus-live evidence boundary as an explicit web brick.
created_by.intent: Make proof understandable without allowing bundled cockpit fixtures to masquerade as a user receipt.
created_by.decision_rationale: A pure verdict model and route-local server view add the missing boundary without introducing runtime side effects.

verification.command: production deploy and stable-domain mobile/4K browser proof
verification.notes: Netlify deploy 6a561648e30ad41a89ca1a88 serves the committed verdict at the public custom domain with four Lighthouse 100 scores.

touched_by.summary: Promoted and verified the fixture-versus-live proof boundary on the stable VibeUsage domain.
touched_by.intent: Bind the product claim to an immutable deploy and public runtime evidence.
touched_by.decision_rationale: A deploy command alone does not prove custom-domain routing, responsive layout, accessibility, or the absence of runtime data calls.
